decisions.evidence: R1 maker: baseline spec presented saving that (per client's reading) 'only makes up a fallback title and deliberately doesn't reach out to the page'. R1 client pt.1: 'I want it to actually go grab the page's real title, its short description, the little site icon, and if possible a preview image, and fill those in for me automatically. I'd still want to be able to change any of that before or after saving ... that's not what I want.' R2 maker then adds 'Automatic title, description, site-icon, and preview-image retrieval'.
decisions.note: Presentation actively contradicts REF-BM-02 (deliberately no fetch). Client rejects the mismatch and supplies the reference-conforming behaviour (real metadata capture + editable before/after, REF-BM-03). Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker baseline omits any unread workflow. R1 client pt.2: 'A read it later pile ... flag links I haven't gotten to yet, and have a spot that shows me only those unread ones — and marking one as read takes it off that list. I don't see that here.' R2 maker adds 'A separate Read Later/unread workflow'.
decisions.note: Reference requires REF-BM-17/18/19 (mark unread, view unread only, mark read removes); absent from presentation. Client requests the missing reference requirement. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker baseline has only deletion. R1 client pt.3: 'Archiving, not just deleting ... tuck it away so it's out of my main list and searches, but I can still go to an archived area ... Delete should be the permanent one; archive should be the reversible one.' R2 maker adds 'Reversible archiving and distinct permanent deletion'.
decisions.note: Reference requires archive hiding from default list/search (REF-BM-26), archive-vs-delete distinction (REF-BM-27), separate archived list (REF-BM-28); absent. Client requests the missing requirement. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker baseline lacks bulk actions. R1 client pt.4: 'select several bookmarks and, say, tag them all, mark them read, archive them, or delete them in one go — including everything that matches whatever I'm currently filtered to.' R2 maker adds 'Individual selection and select all matching bulk actions'.
decisions.note: Reference requires multi-select bulk action (REF-BM-20) and apply-to-whole-matching-filter (REF-BM-21); absent. Client requests the missing requirement. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker baseline has only plain search/filter/sort. R1 client pt.5: 'search by tag directly (something like typing #news)'. R2 maker adds '#tag ... searching'.
decisions.note: Reference requires #tag search syntax (REF-BM-14); absent from presented scope. Client requests it. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker baseline lacks boolean search. R1 client pt.5: 'combine terms with and/or/not'. R2 maker adds 'AND/OR/NOT searching'. R3 client also confirms the quoting rule: 'if I quote a word like AND it's treated as plain text and not as a command. That's the behavior I wanted.'
decisions.note: Reference requires AND/OR/NOT operators with the quoted-literal rule (REF-BM-15); absent. Client requests it (single decision; R3 confirmation of the same item, not a separate opportunity). Specification/plan gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker baseline lacks phrase search. R1 client pt.5: 'search an exact phrase in quotes'. R2 maker adds 'quoted-phrase ... searching'.
decisions.note: Reference requires quoted exact-phrase match (REF-BM-16); absent. Client requests it. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker baseline lacks tag autocomplete. R1 client pt.5: 'when I'm typing a tag onto a bookmark, it should suggest tags I already use.' R2 maker adds 'Existing-tag suggestions'.
decisions.note: Reference requires existing-tag autocomplete on tag entry (REF-BM-10); absent. Client requests it. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker baseline has only a short description. R1 client pt.6: 'a place to jot a fuller note on a bookmark with a bit of formatting, and see it nicely when I open the bookmark.' R2 maker adds 'longer formatted notes'.
decisions.note: Reference requires markdown note with rendered view (REF-BM-23); absent. Client requests it. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker baseline lacks saved searches. R1 client pt.7: 'If I set up a search with certain tags included and excluded, I'd like to save that combination and jump back to it later.' R2 maker adds 'Reusable saved searches'.
decisions.note: Reference requires saving a search term + included/excluded tags as a reusable bundle (REF-BM-29); absent. Client requests it. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker presents 'clear first-release exclusions'. R1 client: 'A couple of things like importing/exporting from a browser I'm happy to leave for later.' R2 client (fuller): 'down the road I'll want to bring in bookmarks I already have from my browser and get them back out again ... but I'm fine leaving those out of this first version.' Reaffirmed R6.
decisions.note: Reference (extended) requires Netscape HTML import/export (REF-BM-30/31); deferred by presentation. Client explicitly states the expectation (import + export) AND accepts the departure without requesting alignment — accepted_divergence, catch_type=none. Counted once. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker presents first-release exclusions. R2 client: 'possibly keep a saved copy of a page's contents — but I'm fine leaving those out of this first version.' R6 client: 'maybe keep a saved copy of a page. We agreed those wait, and I'm glad to accept the app as it stands.'
decisions.note: Reference (extended) requires page snapshot / Internet Archive snapshot (REF-BM-24/25); deferred by presentation. Client explicitly expresses the expectation (saved copy of a page) and accepts leaving it out — accepted_divergence, catch_type=none. Counted once. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: covers 'saving ... bookmarks'. R1 client: 'saving links ... That part reads right to me.' Confirmed hands-on R5: 'When I dropped in a link it pulled the real page title straightaway.'
decisions.note: Save a bookmark by url conforms to reference; approved. Recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'editing ... bookmarks'. R1 client: 'editing and deleting them ... reads right to me.'
decisions.note: Edit bookmark conforms to reference; approved. Recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'deleting ... bookmarks'. R1 client: 'deleting them ... reads right to me.'
decisions.note: Delete bookmark conforms to reference; approved. Recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'duplicate detection'. R1 client: 'the duplicate warning ... reads right to me.' Confirmed R6: 'when I tried to save a link I already had, it stopped me and pointed me to the one that's already there instead of making a second copy.'
decisions.note: Re-saving an existing url converges to editing the existing bookmark (REF-BM-06); conforms and approved. Recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'tags'. R1 client raises a clarification: 'I want to be sure tags stay the main way I organize and that a link can carry several. Collections on top of that are fine, but they shouldn't replace flexible tagging.' R2 maker: 'Tags as the primary many-to-many organization model'; R2 client: 'Tags being the main way I organize with collections as an optional extra — that's the balance I wanted.'
decisions.note: Assign one or more tags (many-to-many, REF-BM-09) conforms; the client's collections clarification is resolved to the conforming disposition. Collections itself is orthogonal to the reference (not a reference item) and excluded. Recorded conforming decision; not double-counted with a pending clarification.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'search/filter/sort'. R1 client: 'searching and sorting ... reads right to me.' (Advanced search operators handled as separate REF-BM-14/15/16 corrections.)
decisions.note: Basic full-text search present and conforming (REF-BM-12); approved. Recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'search/filter/sort'. R1 client: 'searching and sorting ... reads right to me.'
decisions.note: Sort by a sort key (REF-BM-22) conforms; approved. Recorded conforming decision.
